body:
Procedure; no authority.

SOURCES
Greg: clean review/green tests permit check-in without credit prerequisite (2026-10-24); autonomous exact-tree integration/push/install; Greg restarts (DIRECT 2026-10-25,r21/7eaaea12). No Merger fixes. Fable2 slots/one full gate. Current Git-identity/minimal-check/commit-message rules; sources r42.

CODER -> MERGER
Greg DIRECT 2026-10-25: "Coder powien cie poinformawac TYLKO WTEDY kiedy paczka jest gotowa do merge".
READY: independent pair, no unresolved in-scope Medium+, findings dispositioned, relevant/new focused tests passed on exact input; cover cross-component boundaries. No Coder full gate. Cite final-code/test/doc pair ids and verdicts; Coder owns findings/coverage. No routine config/prompt/packet/prose export audit. Return incomplete READY; no extra Merger review/pair/repeated tests on unchanged input. Progress/START/END/test-pass/unfinished reviews go to task/coordinator. rules-merger-role r4/r5.

Each review attempt needs its original complete structured result; missing/failed submission is unavailable, not clean. Recovery follows joint Engram rules-merger-role r33 (Architect3 #101/ebb8a35b): eligible roots in the original project automatically read exact attempts as themselves, nonexclusively; no parent consent, manual designation, Greg intervention, new scheduler or repeated review. No parent identity, child control, gate credit or landing authority is granted. Capability unshipped: record the access gap; prose cannot replace results. Restore Engram first; do not delay Fable's repair.

EXECUTION
1. READY cites owner/root/base, complete Git tree, counted pair delegation ids/verdicts and launcher run/result/counts/own before-after fingerprint. Check tree/base and launcher-isolated clean status; tracked bytes must equal the test ref. No routine file/blob/patch hashes, byte audits, export indices, saved-config/prompt requirements, run copying or manual pin rehash; launcher checks --engram-sha256. Keep evidence in place. An explicit item criterion may need more. Unchanged transfer repair needs no new review/test. Route defects to owner.
2. Claim/accept natively; exclusive root use; integrate on authorized current master. Return any conflict or product/test/fixture/doc fix, even one line, to its Coder for repaired/reviewed READY. No second Merger review.
3. Before gate: lockfile, private ui/node_modules via npm ci (no junction), TypeScript/Vitest/tools, >=50GiB. Freeze final input; run full launcher once under single-gate ownership or recover exact-input result.
4. Gate truth: cite the launcher's native run id, result, counts and its own before/after fingerprint, with required stages and terminal exit. Do not copy or manually hash run files. STARTED/promises/host credit are not PASS; failed/unrun is not passed; absent result is UNKNOWN. Diagnose with summary/recover, never auto-retry. Changed final tree needs new gate.
5. Land under current standing approval or Greg's recorded acting-session instruction; no repeated human go. Missing evidence -> owner; rule conflicts -> both coordinators. No extra Merger review or criterion/reserved-act waiver. Remote: current remote-test-ref-gates-evidence-only-2026-10-28. Messages: rules-commit-messages.
6. Detached: --notify coordinator (never Architect3); own-project termal_resume_after_test_runs; end turn/freeze root. Record run/dependency, owner, action, deadline/recovery. Before run-state reports, read available coordinator mail and saved terminal results; absent current evidence, state last observation/time. Recover missed wakes from existing results; never rerun for delivery.
7. Check the launcher terminal record before dependent acts/reports; diagnose failures first. Separate observed facts, source defects and hypotheses; unproved order/cause stays UNKNOWN. A predicate test alone proves no historical cause. Identity follows termal-verification-by-git-not-manual-hashes; tree/base/clean status and FF/remote checks remain.

CLAIMS
- Claim before execution independently of evaluations; claims grant no Git/filesystem authority.
- No impersonation, clock or store edits, cancel/reopen, or new tasks to bypass foreign authority; use native claim, handoff and recovery. Deleted-session claim gap: Engram w-b49fa5ee8bf3.
- Separate native handoffs may proceed during unrelated gates only if the original gate's claim/source/root/input/attribution stay unchanged; results never transfer (Architect3 f12beda4).
- Supersedes old evaluation/host-credit/repeat-gate/extra-review requirements only; retain safety/ownership/exact-tree/remote/install rules. Queue in task notes.
- Queue handoff: resolve exact live id; verify project/workdir AND tracker/tool binding, not name. After recreation rediscover successor/readdress offers; old delivery is not its receipt.

CLEANUP (automatic; never an extra gate)
Greg Advisor #7/2d0b8be9 and 2026-10-29 domain #11; canonical greg-2026-10-28-remote-hosts-acceptance-and-worktree-cleanup r3. Existing sweep w-65afd9cec452; no duplicate.
1. AUTOMATIC trigger: successful merge pushed/read back AND work closed. Remove worktree/build output without reminder; integration owner owns handed roots, producers their own.
2. Before removal: absolute path inside repo; no junction/symlink traversal or active claim/process/frozen use; clean/published; all runs terminal/recorded; no pending reviews/notices; open-task/evidence citations checked. Ambiguity is not absence.
3. Retain ONLY for a concrete, recorded, still-active reason on open work, naming owner and end condition; remove when it ends. Preserve evidence; record needed relocation mappings, no routine copies/hash indices.
4. Use git worktree remove without --force; remove inactive derived output. git branch -d only if published/unused, no unique commits. Never -D, broad git clean, unchecked variables or main/master/remote refs.
5. Each landing report lists REMOVE/RETAIN roots/build/evidence and retention reasons; record removals/free-space delta. Last-task closer/sweep removes .logs/.evidence when retention ends.

REPORTING
Send operational reports/requests to Fable2, who owns project work, assignment, decisions, evidence and recovery. Advisor ONLY relays Greg <-> project coordinators; NEVER executes work. Greg DIRECT quoted Architect3 #70/cd2107bb supersedes older Advisor duties (Engram roles r8/waits r8/merger r19).
Architect3 receives collaboration failures needing rule correction, with facts/evidence/impact/owner/action; product failures only for collaboration intervention. No routine status/success, --notify or recovery; Merger/Fable2 recover.
Task/queue: fix/status/ref. Landed/pushed/installed awaiting evaluation: "DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING", with commit/build evidence and closure pending; never missing implementation/test/review/merge/install.

EVALUATIONS: HYBRID
Greg: greg-2026-10-28-evaluations-on-remote-hosts r2; Fable654. Independent CENTRAL evaluator uses native REMOTE evidence for the exact Git tree/build and the launcher's own identity record, without routine manual export hashes. R7: later item-path changes invalidate old records. Without typed remote check, typed-test criteria stay OPEN/insufficient_evidence; no note/gate-ref shortcut. Evaluate singly; done on fresh PASS. Mac needs Mac evidence. No policy/store/config bypass or new landing/restart authority.

MEMORY UPKEEP AND COLLABORATION REPORTS
Sole editor Merger2; peers send corrections. No parallel edits. Name a successor on transfer; consolidate/full-read verify.
Read thread mail before publishing; reconcile supersession. Correct withdrawals promptly; record affected actions/delivery times. No approval wait.
Cross-project corrections name exact text/revision. Verify own procedure; distinguish source read from relay. Project-scoped memory_not_found is not an empty rule.
Collaboration failures go to Architect3 and, through Fable2, Advisor (#70 supersedes prior route).
Greg/Architect3 ed31c20d: inspect failures, correct canonical rule without asking, task history. Full-read/distribute corrections; verify effect from task evidence. Preserve authority; retire ended workarounds/update refs/name retirement items.
